basic_info.description: 153-159 Varennes Street is a beautifully maintained fourplex, ideal for investors and owner-occupants seeking the perfect blend of city living, architectural character, and promising investment returns. With three units currently rented and generating $10,450/month, the property offers the ability to substantially offset a mortgage while living in a great condo style unit in a top-tier location. Built in 1906 and thoughtfully updated over time, the building spans approximately 4,298 square feet and features a flexible and highly desirable unit mix:  Live Upstairs in Style: Two expansive, two-level 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom upper units offer:  -High ceilings, skylights, and natural light-filled living spaces  -Fireplaces, upgraded kitchens, and private sun decks  -Sweeping views from the Financial District to the Golden Gate Bridge  -Central heat, ample closets, and in-unit laundry potential  -Perfect for high paying tenants and owner-occupants looking for comfort, space, and style  -Two dedicated parking spaces for each unit      Lower Unit Apartments: Two inviting 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom units offer:  -Period charm   -Practical layouts  -One dedicated parking space for each unit  -Excellent rental appeal in this high-demand location
